title: Spinach Feta Egg Bites
description: Baked egg muffins with spinach, red pepper and feta. Make a tray on Sunday and reheat a couple each morning in under a minute.

image.alt: A muffin tin of egg bites with spinach and feta

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 350F oven} with a rack in the middle. Brush the muffin cups generously with oil, or use silicone liners.
Heat the oil in the skillet over medium heat. Cook the bell pepper until soft, {time 4 min}, then add the spinach and stir until wilted, {time 1-2 min}. Let it cool a little.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper in a large measuring jug or bowl until smooth.
Divide the vegetables and feta among the muffin cups, then pour the egg mixture over them, filling each cup about three-quarters full.
Bake until puffed and set in the center, {time 20-24 min}. Cool in the tin for {time 5 min}, then run a thin knife around each one and lift it out.

notes: Refrigerate in a covered container for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months. Reheat in the microwave for 30 to 60 seconds.
The bites puff in the oven and settle as they cool; that’s expected.
